import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided CSV and aggregate revenue by month and region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
revenue = df.groupby(['month', 'region'])['revenue'].sum().unstack()
months = revenue.index.tolist()
x = range(len(months))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
# Draw EU first so US appears in front at the same x positions.
ax.bar(x, revenue['EU'], label='EU', color='tab:orange')
ax.bar(x, revenue['US'], label='US', color='tab:blue')
ax.set_xticks(list(x), months)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_title('Monthly Revenue by Region')
ax.set_ylim(0, max(revenue['EU'].max(), revenue['US'].max()) * 1.1)
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
